race.comment: POSSIBILITIES (2) is a consistent conveyance who has hit the top-four at her past 16 starts and doesn't know how to put in a poor one. Strips fitter third run back and again gets the services of Maloney on board from a low draw. Plenty to like about her prospects. WOUNDER (5) is another honest campaigner who placed around this circuit last time out and looks ready for the step-up in trip now. Hard to beat in this suitable contest. POWER PACK (1) has placed three of four over this staying journey and will be high on confidence following that last-start victory here. In the mix. EMPIRE OF ART (6) has placed three of four around this circuit and must be respected out of the champion Waller yard. Can trouble the judge with luck in running.
